title: Quiet Artsy East Nashville Walkability + Park free
description:
No cleaning chores on checkout | Free off street parking | Quiet neighborhood in East Nashville artsy district walkable to cool restaurants and bars. Just 5-10 minute ride to Broadway honkytonk central. 15 minutes ride to the airport and the Grand Ole Opry.  You have the unit entirely to yourself and everything you need from bedding, towels, bathroom items and cookware. I include a Nashville visitor guide with our best local recommendations

The space
This is the private upstairs apartment/entire floor, of a 2 story home, so you have everything to yourself(private entrance, kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, living room, and your own parking space off the street). The space sleeps up to 4 people with a standard queen bed for 2, and an available queen air mattress or convertible couch for 2 more.

Guest access
Early check-in and Late checkout sometimes available if prearranged for a small fee | 
Private entrance with a keypad to let yourself in on your schedule

Other things to note
The TV has access to all the normal apps through Roku, or antenna for lots of local channels. This is an upstairs apartment so, have fun but this is a quiet house in a quiet neighborhood. No loud noise or groups bigger than the reservation
